name: rulewright
description: Session-first rules doctor for Codex agent runs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn failed Codex sessions into durable rules.
interface.longDescription: Rulewright reads Codex thread history, identifies agent-behavior correction events, and proposes narrow patches for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor, or Copilot instruction files.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Rulewright to analyze a Codex session and propose a project-rule patch.
